title: Fruit By Supergood Banana & Mango 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Fruit by Supergood Banana and Mango is a luscious tropical pairing crafted by the experts at Supergood. This flavour combines the rich, creamy sweetness of ripe Bananas with the vibrant, juicy exotic notes of fresh Mango. It is a smooth, sun-soaked blend that delivers a perfectly balanced and authentic fruit experience from start to finish. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is formulated for MTL vaping. It’s ideal for use with Starter vape kits and pod mods, producing dense, satisfying clouds and exceptional flavour clarity. This 100ml shortfill is supplied in a 120ml bottle, leaving space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 10ml 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This allows you to customise your nicotine strength while enjoying the incredible value of a larger bottle. The "Fruit" collection is the latest innovation from Supergood, a premium UK manufacturer famous for their "Butter" and "Cocktail" ranges. Moving away from heavy desserts, this range focuses on delivering the most authentic and refreshing fruit profiles imaginable.
